slots.title: Strangers are begging the Binance hacker for bitcoin, one ‘help me bro’ at a time
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The 19 wallets holding 18,270 stolen BTC have taken in nothing since Thursday except payments worth under a dollar, each carrying a message, from pleas to laundering pitches to a token shill.

slots.title: AI agents bypassed crypto spending limits without human approval, researchers find in a new test
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The researchers say any approval an agent can reach is unreliable, and they built Countersign, an app tying approval to a physical action the agent can’t fake.
slots.reason: A major development affecting both AI and blockchain

slots.title: BTCPay, a bitcoin payment tool, tells users to switch off their servers after reports of drained wallets
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The open-source project says it is still investigating and hasn't given a loss figure or announced a fix. Its founder said the reports appear to involve versions older than 2.4.2.
